lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for the Marshall Islands region. The dataset represents approximately 100% coverage of buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 7 years and recent updates within the last 6 months. Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment.
